Service area

Wollongong to Newcastle, and the whole corridor between

Western Sydney · Northern Beaches · South West Sydney · Hills District · Inner West and Ryde · St George and Sutherland · North Shore · Eastern Suburbs · Penrith and Hawkesbury · Illawarra · Central Coast · Newcastle and Lake Macquarie.

Western Sydney and the Northern Beaches are where we are most often, so there is no travel loading on work in either. Everywhere else is quoted with the travel accounted for honestly rather than buried in the rates, and if a job is too far out to be economic we will say so rather than price it and hope.

Max Demolition and Excavation holds demolition licence AD214737, issued by SafeWork NSW. It is a public register and worth checking against any demolition contractor before you sign.
